title: High-score Worker operations
description: The routes the Samosa Worker answers; everything else under its routes is a static asset.

entities.name: Open the game
entities.description: The game's page, for players who are signed in.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole).
entities.result: The page from the static assets, marked Cache-Control: private, no-cache.
failures: Signed out, or the login service out of reach: a redirect to /auth/sign-in that returns to the same address afterwards.
Signed in without the role: 403 Not allowed.

entities.name: Issue a reign's seed
entities.description: Starts a reign that may later enter the table.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true), checked for every POST under the API.
entities.result: { id, seed }: a new random id and 32-bit seed, stored as unused. Unused seeds older than 24 hours are deleted on the way.
failures: Signed in without the role: 403 { code: "forbidden" }.

entities.name: Submit a reign
entities.description: Puts a finished reign on the table, after replaying it.
entities.authorization: Signed in to icelander.net with the games:play role (AUTH.requireRole, with api: true).
entities.result: The reign is replayed from its seed and keys; the seed is marked used and the replay's score, months and fate stored under the cleaned name. Returns { score, rank, name }, the rank counting every reign that scored at least as much.
failures: An id that is not a string of at most 64 characters: 400 bad game id.
keys not an array of at most 20,000 strings of at most 12 characters: 400 bad keys.
A name that cleans to nothing: 400 bad name.
A seed that is unknown, used or older than 24 hours, or claimed by another submission during the replay: 409.
Keys that do not play exactly one whole reign: 422.

entities.name: Read the table
entities.description: The best ten reigns, as JSON for the game's own table.
entities.result: { scores: [{ name, score, months, alive }] }, best first, ties oldest first.

entities.name: Show the scores page
entities.description: The best 25 reigns as a web page in icelander.net's look.
entities.result: An HTML page with each reign's rank, name (escaped), score, months and fate (Fled or Died); /games/retro/samosa/scores redirects to it with 301.

entities.name: Follow the old address
entities.description: Sends anything under the first address to the same place at the current one.
entities.transport: Any method, icelander.net/retro-games/samosa and every path under it
entities.result: 308 to https://icelander.net/games/retro/samosa with the same rest of the path and query; 308 keeps the method.

relatedViews.relationship: The use case that calls them.
